title: garuga pinnata var. pierrei
intro: Garuga pinnata var. pierrei, commonly known as the Indian walnut, is a deciduous tree species native to Southeast Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include its ability to treat various health conditions, such as fever, rheumatism, and skin disorders. The health benefits of G. pinnata var. pierrei include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in reducing inflammation, fighting infections, and protecting against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
